name: latitude
note: model point latitude (degrees): the NASA POWER point at INIA La Estanzuela; used by the Hargreaves ET0

name: longitude
note: model point longitude (degrees): the NASA POWER point at INIA La Estanzuela; the model runs only here

name: season_first_year
note: first season whose window lies inside the POWER record (record starts 1 Jan 1986)

name: season_last_year
note: last season whose window lies inside the POWER record (record ends 11 Nov 2026)

name: et0_scale
note: multiplies Hargreaves ET0 so it matches the station's Penman ET on average (ratio of totals, 1986-2026, same location as the model point); refit the soil parameters after changing it
